summary.name: Punch Needle Israel
summary.one_liner: A punch needle community site from Ramat HaSharon, Israel, offering an AI pattern generator that turns images or text into yarn and color maps, plus in-person workshops.
use_cases: Turning a photo into a punch needle pattern
Creating a punch needle design from a text idea
Learning punch needle in person in Ramat HaSharon
Getting yarn and color work order for a project
summary.what_it_does: The site offers a pattern generator that turns an uploaded image or a text idea into a punch-needle map showing yarns, colors and work order. Directory listings describe exports to PDF, PNG and SVG. It also advertises hands-on punch needle workshops in Ramat HaSharon, with a typical workshop of about 2.5 hours. The page shows a gallery of recent AI-generated designs prompted by user requests. Stated usage figures include over 2,400 patterns generated.
notable: AI pattern generator producing color-coded yarn maps and work order from images or text
In-person punch needle workshops in Ramat HaSharon, Israel
Exports listed as PDF, PNG and SVG
caveats: Pricing tier is only described as freemium in directory listings; the page itself does not state plan details
Workshops are location-specific to Ramat HaSharon, Israel
